title: Exact influence of even majority
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, and let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $(2m+2)$-dimensional cube whose value agrees with the sign of the sum of the input coordinates whenever that sum is nonzero. Then its total influence is $\displaystyle (2m+1)\binom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $(2m+2)$-dimensional cube
At every input with nonzero coordinate sum, $f$ equals the sign of that sum
